cards.etymology: Heart (心) sheltered under a roof — love as something cherished and protected.
An enclosure (囗) around a person (井) — walls closing in on all sides.
Grain (禾) next to many people (多) — a whole crop of people moving on.
A person (大) inside a container (囗) — boxed in by a cause, dependent on it.
A hand pressing down on a kneeling figure — the impression of an official seal.
Water (氵) with a night figure (夜) — fluid flowing in the dark like a night river.
Water (氵) spreading over everything — flowing through a performance.
Heart (心) in a broad space — the heart opening up in response.
Water (氵) and a dish (皿) of sun — a bowl warmed by sunlight.
Words (言) and fruit (果) — speaking results, assigning tasks bearing fruit.
Self (己) struck by a stick (攴) — beating old habits out to change for the better.
A horn (角) being cut (刀) from a cow (牛) — breaking something apart piece by piece.
Tree (木) arriving at (各) a destination — the proper place in a hierarchy.
Stone (石) and a bird (隹) — something as solid and reliable as a rock.
Guest (客) on top of a head (頁) — the broad brow, like a framed picture.
A knife (刂) splitting (害 root) — cutting cleanly in proportion.
Bamboo (竹) over an official (官) — a bamboo pipe, or a bureaucratic channel.
Heart (心) and a thread of habit (貫) — the heart pierced through by repetition.
Wood (木) and a weaving mechanism (幾) — the loom as the original machine.
A mound of earth (土) under a frame (其) — the base layer on which everything rests.
See (見) with a compass (夫) — drawing the circle that sets the rule.
Words (言) balanced on righteousness (義) — careful speech in council.
A seeker (求) struck upright (攴) — reaching out to pull someone free.
Thread (糸) combined with a meeting (合) — threads distributed to those who gather.
Two hands lifting from below — raising something up with both hands.
Words (言) next to a sound (午) — speaking approval, granting permission.
Earth (土) and a capital (京) region — the edge where territories meet.
Two standing people (兄×2) facing off — rivals standing toe to toe.
Earth (土) pressed by a thorn frame (刑) — a shape pressed into clay to make a mold.
Thread (糸) pulling down — a continuous line of descent or connection.
Thread (糸) woven through a frame — threads running through the warp, time passing.
Words (言) coming from someone who strikes (敬) — a sharp warning delivered with force.
Person (亻) and a bull (牛) — a head of cattle as a countable item, a case.
Water (氵) that has all dried up — a level that has dropped.
Mound (阜) with a root going deep (艮) — a hill that sets a hard boundary.
King (王) gem coming to the surface (見) — the jewel revealing itself, the present moment.
Words (言) and a tangled path — saying something that goes off course.
Crossing (交) with strength (力) — effort that crosses over and produces a result.
Tree (木) with a crisscross lattice (冓) — a wooden frame set up in position.
A hand inserting under grain (禾) — the gap created when things don't line up.
Hand (爪) gathering from a tree (木) — reaching up to pluck the best choice.
Water (氵) crossing completely (斉) — finishing a crossing, settling a debt.
Mound (阜) and a sacrificial fire (祭) — meeting at the ritual boundary, the edge.
Trees (木×3) and a bird (隹) — many birds in many trees, a mixed jumble.
Two shells (貝×2) offered together — bringing contributions, showing agreement.
Next (次) and shell/money (貝) — next in line comes the money, resources.
Two axes (斤×2) next to money (貝) — weighing material value, the substance of a thing.
A hand (又) pulling in — reaching out and drawing in.
Hand (扌) receiving from another (受) — passing knowledge from one to another.
Many hands carrying a shape — handing something along, acknowledging.
Hand (扌) and a mouth calling (召) — waving and calling someone over.
Moon (月) and force (力) — mustering all strength to overcome.
Dog (犬) and a tree shape — a posture giving the shape of a situation.
Cloth (巾) hanging from a roof (尚) — a banner always hanging there, the norm.
Eye (目) looking at sparse (少) details — examining carefully, cutting away the rest.
Bundle (束) and a right hand striking (攴) — neatly lining things up.
Water (氵) and blue-green (青) — water as clear and clean as a blue sky.
Grain (禾) removed (兌) — grain taken away by the state as tribute.
Earth (土) stacking up (曾) — layers building up, growing larger.
Hand (扌) and dawn (旦) — picking up the load at dawn, shouldering responsibility.
A hand striking (殳) at ascending levels — steps carved by force, rising in grade.
Axe (斤) cutting threads (糸) — slicing cleanly through to decide or refuse.
Person (亻) and straight (直) — one person's straightforward measure of worth.
Way (道) with an added stroke of the hand — walking ahead to show the way.
Thread (糸) and a general — threads pulled together under one command.
Step (彳) and a hand holding a shell (貝) — moving and picking up profit along the way.
Words (言) and a tolerating blade (忍) — speaking carefully to acknowledge a truth.
Stone (石) and the skin (皮) — a rock that tears through the surface.
Splitting (弗) money (貝) apart — coins dispersed, money spent.
Shelter (广) over a hand and a gift (付) — a storeroom of government provisions.
Clothing (衤) with a repeated interior — a garment with a double lining.
A balance with evenly spread water — perfectly level and at peace.
Hands seizing and kneeling — binding something to give back as a report or reward.
Water (氵) and both hands overflowing — a vessel filled to the brim.
Words (言) and a branching split — splitting meaning across languages.
Person (人) with food left over — more than enough, the remainder.
Roof (宀) over a valley (谷) — a sheltered space that holds things.
A cord with threads pulled through a mesh — the proportion of strands passing through.
Step (彳) and a writing brush (聿) — the pace set by written rules.
Field (田) mapped out (各) — a quick sketch of the territory, an outline.
A page (頁) of orders — the leader whose head commands a domain.
Movement (辶) and a cart (車) — vehicles rolling one after another in a line.
Metal (金) and a continuous water flow (彔) — engraving marks that flow one after another.
